title: How the walk over the ownership of a dependency store reports its counts and saves its listings
description: The ownership walk of `repo dependencies sync` visits every directory below the workspace (millions of steps on a machine with a large `node_modules`) and used to print only the name of its latest step, labelled like a lock; a walk that the stage cap stopped lost every listing it had read and began again. Now the walk prints a count line every `reportMilliseconds` (steps so far, steps per second since the start and since the last line, in English and German), and saves the listings it has settled every `checkpointMilliseconds` once at least `checkpointMinimumOperations` steps are new, so the next try is seeded with them and goes on where this one stopped.
